prompts: Use case: logo-brand. Create one standalone square avatar image for Premium Emoji App. The central subject is the recognizable Telegram Premium badge style FIVE-POINTED star: one point straight upward, two lateral points and two lower points, softly rounded tips, solid balanced silhouette. It should immediately evoke the purple premium star displayed beside a Telegram user's name. No face, no eyes, no letters, no text, no watermark, no other icons, no collage. Centered large star occupies 65 percent of square, with all tips inside the safe circular avatar crop. Dark charcoal background. Strong tiny-size readability. Variant: polished dimensional 3D premium badge, chunky gently inflated star with smooth rounded bevels, saturated violet to luminous lilac gradient, tasteful glossy highlights and restrained soft violet halo. Front-facing, luxurious clean app icon, minimal scene.
